hermes-cron-automated-reports
1.0.0

  • Rich HTML reports
  • Long Unicode arrows
  • Excessive bold markers
  • Content length

  1. `cronjob(action='remove', job_id='...')`
  2. `cronjob(action='create', ...)` with the desired mode
  3. Collect balance checkpoints in a JSON history file (as above)
  4. Find the window spanning ~24h from the most recent history entries
  5. Compute `(first_balance - last_balance) * (24 / hours_elapsed)` to get average daily burn
  6. Estimate `days_remaining = current_balance / daily_burn`

  • **Cron agent cannot use the memory tool** — read MEMORY.md/USER.md directly via file tools at `~/.hermes/memories/`.
  • **Do NOT auto-rewrite** — the review should be read-only.
  • **If memory is already at 99%, the review is the symptom** — do manual consolidation first.
  • **The review itself consumes negligible capacity** (~500 tokens per run).
